articles.title: Tech stocks' resilience has puzzled investors. The options market could hold some clues
articles.summary: The unexpected never happens when you're looking for it, which may explain why tech stocks have remained so strong in the face of surging rates and questions about the AI complex. The metric isn't just the result of a one-day anomaly: the ratio has been moving in favor of puts since August, despite a steady climb in big-tech stock prices that culminated in a string of all-time highs up through Tuesday.

articles.title: OpenAI's revenue scare, Delta earnings, what investors think of a Starbucks-Chipotle deal and more in Morning Squawk
articles.summary: The news from one of the most dominant players in the artificial intelligence ecosystem led stocks across the tech sector to slide. Here's what to know: - As CNBC's Ashley Capoot and Kate Rooney write, the new details on OpenAI's revenue come as the company faces pressure to justify its enormous valuation ahead of its potential IPO. - The drop in AI names pushed the technology-heavy Nasdaq Composite down more than 1%, its worst day since mid-August.

articles.title: Ferrari’s chairman is bullish on AI. He’s less certain how businesses will cash in
articles.summary: Ferrari chairman John Elkann has shrugged off concerns about a potential artificial intelligence bubble — but he warns an AI supply and demand mismatch could pose a risk to markets. In an exclusive interview with CNBC Friday, the billionaire industrialist and Meta Platforms board member, who has invested in technology companies through his family's holding company Exor, expressed optimism for the AI buildout in the decade ahead.

articles.title: Kalshi traders see high odds that more than 5,100 data centers will be planned or operating before 2027
articles.summary: Public backlash is rising against the construction of data centers, but Kalshi traders see a higher likelihood that the number of data centers planned or operating before the new year will top 5,000 Prediction market platform Kalshi shows a 75% chance that there will be more than 5,100 proposed and live data centers before 2027. In just two weeks, the likelihood has jumped from 60%.

articles.title: CNBC Daily Open: What happened to the $20 billion?
articles.summary: OpenAI's latest annual revenue estimate, confirmed by CNBC, has spooked investors by falling short of previous statements, and the market has taken it out on technology stocks. First revealed by the Financial Times, the discrepancy spooked investors, who flocked to sell AI stocks from Nvidia to Oracle to CoreWeave. CEO Sam Altman has confirmed the group will not try to IPO this year, but the company is still looking to justify a valuation that tops $850 billion.

articles.title: Nvidia-backed Aussie AI firm Firmus withdraws historic IPO, citing market volatility
articles.summary: Australian AI data center operator Firmus, which is backed by Nvidia, has withdrawn its planned mega initial public offering, citing market volatility and conditions, the company said in an emailed statement to CNBC. Firmus had reportedly planned to raise $5 billion in its IPO, pricing shares at A$11 apiece, which woul have made it the second-largest new share sale in Australia's history.

articles.title: Pepsi shares rallied despite cutting profit guidance. Where Cramer stands on the stock now
articles.summary: Shares rallied 3% following the report, as investors focused on improving sales trends and a guidance cut that had been widely anticipated. However, given the reason for the forecast cut and the stock's relatively low valuation, "I'm feeling a lot better about this story. More recently, rising inflation, oil prices and interest rates added to the pressure, sending PepsiCo shares down nearly 10% in September alone.

articles.title: SpaceX deal to acquire spectrum license hammers shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile
articles.summary: Shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile tumbled in extended trading. SpaceX, which went public in June in a record IPO and is now valued at over $2 trillion, has relied on Starlink as its cash cow and only profitable business segment to date. For now, its space and artificial intelligence units are losing money.

articles.title: Treasury yields are 'really, really high' but can come down soon, Bessent's new advisor says
articles.summary: Yields in the global bond market have been on a tear as expectations grow for central banks to hike interest rates and corporations keep borrowing money to build out artificial intelligence infrastructure. Central bank officials signaled this week that more increases could be coming before the end of the year. Fed funds futures traders anticipate a more than 82% likelihood that the central bank will next increase borrowing costs at its December meeting, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

articles.title: Why a Starbucks takeover of Chipotle would — and wouldn't — make sense for both companies
articles.summary: Starbucks has reportedly explored buying Chipotle Mexican Grill, but investors are split on whether the megadeal would make sense for both companies. The report sent Chipotle stock up about 7% in afternoon trading, while shares of Starbucks fell roughly 4%. It is not unusual for deal rumors to lower the potential acquirer's value and increase the target's share price, but investor reactions show that a prospective takeover comes with pros and cons for each side of the deal.

articles.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
articles.summary: Shares of Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other artificial intelligence names sank lower on Thursday after the market learned more details about OpenAI's revenue. The company is under pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors as it gears up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO. In the interim, OpenAI is engaging in early stage discussions with investors about a potential new funding round.

articles.title: Treasury sanctions 17 tankers linked to Iran's 'shadow fleet' in economic pressure campaign
articles.summary: Treasury Department is sanctioning 17 additional vessels it says are connected to Iran's "shadow fleet" used to transport oil and gas out of the country, as Washington tries to choke Tehran's economy to end the war that began over seven months ago. has long said Iran uses illicit oil revenues to fund its regime and related terror proxies and hopes to cripple Tehran's economy by stemming that revenue.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield is little changed as Fed's Waller says more hikes needed, investors await 30-year auction
articles.summary: The yield on the 10-year Treasury was relatively unchanged on Thursday as traders digested comments from a top Federal Reserve official while awaiting another long-dated bond auction. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that more hikes are needed to bring inflation down after around 5-and-a-half years above the central bank's 2% target, but suggested rates did not need to rise immediately.
